file_insights.changes_summary: Added 514 lines of comprehensive test cases for Receiving and ReceivingItem models
key_additions: Comprehensive setUp methods with all required fixtures (User, Warehouse, MaterialCategory, Material, Supplier, PurchaseOrder, Receiving, ReceivingItem)

patterns_discovered.description: All test cases follow Django TestCase conventions with setUp() method initializing complete object graphs needed for tests
Tests create necessary related objects (User, Warehouse, Material, Supplier, PurchaseOrder) before testing target models
Tests validate complex properties like total_received_value and total_value that aggregate related data
Tests cover state transitions (PENDING → INSPECTING → APPROVED/REJECTED) with associated field updates
Tests verify positive quantity constraints and reject invalid values (zero, negative)
Tests verify auto-generated sequential reference numbers with 'RB' prefix (e.g., RB00001)

gotchas_discovered.description: Property uses quantity_accepted when available, falls back to quantity_received. Test confirms this with mixed acceptance scenarios (10 accepted vs 4 accepted from same batch)
User objects created in tests must have status='approved' set explicitly before being used in relations
Tests use timezone.now() for date/datetime fields, requiring proper timezone handling in assertions
All monetary and quantity calculations use Decimal type with explicit precision (e.g., Decimal('50.00'), Decimal('2.5'))
ReceivingItem depends on Receiving, which depends on PurchaseOrder, requiring careful setUp order

approach_outcome.completion_notes: Comprehensive test coverage for Receiving and ReceivingItem models including creation, validation, status workflows, and business logic properties

recommendations.suggestion: Add edge case tests for concurrent Receiving creation to verify reference number uniqueness under race conditions
Consider adding docstrings explaining expected business rules (e.g., why quantity_accepted defaults to quantity_received behavior)
Add tests for cross-field validation (e.g., quantity_accepted ≤ quantity_received, quantity_rejected ≤ quantity_received)
Add tests verifying Receiving status changes trigger PurchaseOrder state updates and inventory adjustments
Consider extracting common setUp code into a shared base test class to reduce duplication between ReceivingTestCase and ReceivingItemTestCase
